description: Library voices (id, name, language, gender) usable as voice_id in create_audio_clip. With include_cloned=true also returns the account's own cloned voices, usable as voice_user_id. Voices are cloned in the CraftStory app, not via the API.

include_cloned.description: Also return the account's cloned voices (default false)

name: list_voices
title: List voices for text-to-speech
